mentions.name: Basil AI
mentions.description: Voice recorder, transcription, and summarization app that runs entirely on-device with no cloud, uploads, or server processing of audio. It includes a web version built with WebAssembly Whisper and native iOS/macOS apps using CoreML, with end-to-end-encrypted sync between web and mobile planned, aiming to be a Simplenote-like app for audio transcription.
mentions.problem: Browser sandbox limits (no background recording, inconsistent model performance) made the web version insufficient, and cloud-based transcription services process users' audio on servers.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building a voice recorder/transcription/summarization app where everything runs on-device. No cloud, no uploads, no servers processing your audio.
